overview: This single-page file index concerns edible fats in the Kwantung Leased Territory and records one item: Dairen despatch no. 123, sent by Grummon on November 13, enclosing copies of a South Manchuria Railway publication on the bean-oil industry in Manchuria and commenting on its contents. The indexed despatch and its enclosures are not present in the surviving OCR text.

subfiles.title: List of papers concerning edible fats in the Kwantung Leased Territory
subfiles.about: A file index records a November 13 despatch from Grummon at Dairen concerning the bean-oil industry in Manchuria.
subfiles.summary: The sheet lists Dairen despatch no. 123 from Grummon to “FE ACC.” According to its précis, the despatch enclosed copies of a South Manchuria Railway publication entitled “Bean Oil Industry in Manchuria” and supplied comments on the publication. Neither the despatch nor the cited enclosures appears in the supplied file text, and no year is given for the November 13 date.

interest: The page is useful chiefly as evidence for a missing or separated consular report and its enclosures. It identifies a South Manchuria Railway publication as a source used by American officials studying Manchurian bean-oil production, illustrating the connection between Japanese colonial economic research and U.S. commercial reporting. Its abbreviated recipient notation and absent year also reveal the limitations of surviving State Department file indexes.
